## Journals

```{r}
source("../R/site.R")
site <- load_literature_site_data("..")
```

```{r, results='asis'}
journals <- site_visible_journals(site$journals)
cat('<ul class="journal-list">')
for (journal in journals) {
  latest <- journal$latest_report
  update_date <- paste0("Updated ", site_format_date(substr(latest$generated_at_utc, 1, 10)))
  cat(sprintf(
    '<li><a href="journals/%s.html">%s</a><span class="journal-update">%s</span></li>',
    site_html_escape(site_slug(journal$id)),
    site_html_escape(journal$name),
    site_html_escape(update_date)
  ))
}
cat('</ul>')
```
